meta.title: Coolapk MCP server
meta.description: Lets DeepSeek Harness read and publish Coolapk content. Adds 18 tools: browse the home feed, hot ranking, latest posts, topics, search, user profiles and comments as a guest; after importing an account cookie it can also publish posts, comment, like, and follow users and topics. Credentials stay in the local %USERPROFILE%\.coolapk-cli\state.json file and are never sent to a third party. Turning this plugin off removes every Coolapk tool immediately.
